effects.contract: conservative: a rule is never claimed unable to change a form without proof; unproven is unknown with a reason. notOnForm (reason no_lhs_match) means the rule's target has no match on the allomorph's own form, including across its morpheme edges, and nothing earlier can change the form: no earlier rule in application order is anything but notOnForm on it (else may_be_fed), and no affix modifies stem material. It is not 'cannot change': bleeding is not considered
effects.listedRuleReasons: the loader's own text for a rule that is not compiled or disabled

requestFields.maxTraceSteps: integer >= 1; counts retained trace nodes across every seed
requestFields.maxWork: integer >= 1; lowers the generation cap for this request
requestFields.trace: boolean, default false; true records each surface's rule steps
requestFields.wordTimeoutMs: integer >= 0; wall-clock deadline for this request

inventory.classToken: the text between the brackets of [token] in a match pattern: the class name, else its XML id when the name is empty, repeated by an earlier class, or not writable in brackets; null when neither spelling reaches the class
inventory.work: one unit per class and per feature value listed

match.zeroWidth: reported: a pattern that can match the empty string reports an empty match at every position its anchors allow

flags.summary: auto|on|off (default off); on is a verification and measurement mode: no warm-up, calibration, budget or minimum batch length, every stage that is valid for the grammar runs on every word (a stage that is not valid is off with its reason) and the whole construction is paid whatever the batch length; auto lets a load-time calibration decide whether a rule-admission filter and a tiled whole-word test, built from the grammar, narrow each word's parse; needs the foma-tools build feature (auto and on); refused with --stats and --word-timeout-ms; --work-columns and --cost-column give the work the selected pipeline spent; prints PREFILTER and PREFILTER-TOTAL lines on stderr; the gate prices parses in full parser work (auto and on turn the cost meter on, with or without --cost-column, so the decision line is the same either way; auto turns it off again after the calibration unless --cost-column is given); analyses equal off on every word whose parse completes in both modes, and a word that is incomplete in either mode (work cap, capture cap) can have a different partial list; batches under 512 words stay plain
